name: Scholarship Scheme for State Minority Communities Pursuing Higher Professional Education/All Post H.S.C Courses.(Part-I{(Technical Course(DTE)}.
description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to the meritorious students belonging to Minority Communities ( Muslim , Buddhist, Christian , Sikh , Parsi , Jain & Jews Community ) to enable them to pursue Professional and Technical Courses.

b) Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.
